title: the horrors in the fog
description: a horror mod pack that is spooky
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0b6c0a068fbd71ea8989bae1ee9e9be2be63a38.png)


A horror modpack that is meant to be terrifying and challenging

*and funny at times*
_________________________________________________________________________________________
-content-

adds many iconic horror mods such as:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- From The Fog "also known as the Herobrine mod"
- The Man From The Fog
- The Midnight Lurker
- The Better Cave Dweller
- The Knocker
- Nyf's Spiders
- Sanity: Descent Into Madness
- Doctor Who: Weeping Angels
- And other mods such as preformance mods, shaders, and guns to help with smoothness and immersion

</details>


_____________________________________________________________________________________
**the mod may have jumpscares**
**and loud effects**
_________________________________________________________

****if you want to be spooked, then this is the modpack for you****

*reccomended with friends*
